The '''Ventrux system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ventrux]].
